caseNameFull: Cabanero v. Torres, Secretary of Labor
attorneys: Mr. Guillermo B. Guevara for petitioners. Messrs. W. H. Lawrence and L. S. Tillotson for respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of the Commonwealth of *662the Philippines, and motion for leave to proceed further in forma pauperis, denied.
